claims.text: Multiple baselines were tested, including a No-Answer baseline and Word Count baseline, to compare with the neural baseline.
BERT-based baselines were also implemented to evaluate performance against the neural baseline.
The study includes a human performance baseline for comparison with the neural baseline.
